preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree, n, is an integer between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) and len(set(a)) == n
preconditions.description: The list a contains exactly n distinct integers, each between 1 and n inclusive, representing vertex values.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges) and is_tree(edges, n)
preconditions.description: The edges form a valid tree with n vertices, where is_tree(edges, n) checks for connectivity and acyclicity.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str((P * pow(Q, -1, MOD) - 1) % MOD) and P == numerator and Q == denominator and gcd(P, Q) == 1
postconditions.description: The output is the string representation of (P·Q⁻¹ - 1) mod 10⁹+7, where P/Q is the irreducible fraction representing the expected value of f(u, v) over all ordered pairs (u, v) with u ≠ v. Here, MOD = 10⁹+7, and numerator/denominator are the reduced form of the expected value.

postconditions.expression: numerator == sum(φ(a[u-1] * a[v-1]) * d(u, v) for u in range(1, n+1) for v in range(1, n+1) if u != v) and denominator == n * (n - 1)
postconditions.description: The expected value is computed as the sum of φ(a_u·a_v)·d(u, v) for all ordered pairs (u, v) with u ≠ v, divided by n·(n-1). Here, φ is Euler's totient function, and d(u, v) is the shortest distance between vertices u and v in the tree.
